cohort: The study included all 2,141,709 persons born as singleton live births in Sweden between 1973 and 1994.
finding: Preterm and early-term birth were associated with an increased risk of ischemic heart disease (IHD) in adulthood, with preterm birth having an adjusted hazard ratio of 1.53 and early-term birth an adjusted hazard ratio of 1.19 compared to full-term birth.
gest_age: All gestational ages of singleton live births were included and categorized (preterm <37 weeks, early-term 37-38 weeks, full-term 39-41 weeks).
